goal: Allow wallets to test 1-parent-1-child package acceptance and RBF without modifying the mempool
Enable pre-flight checks for CPFP fee bumping where aggregate feerates or sibling eviction are required
agreement: Concept approval citing the usefulness of dry-running 1p1c package acceptance for wallets (ismaelsadeeq)
Suggests verifying downstream user demand before committing to maintain the new RPC (dergoegge)
Suggests splitting out the internal validation dry-run if RPC demand is not established (andrewtoth)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it enables dry-run package validation for wallet tooling without altering core mempool policy
Modifies validation internals for aggregate feerates and RBF evaluation without affecting relay or DoS rules

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it introduces the testsubmitpackage RPC to resolve an established gap for wallet developers
Fulfills a frequent feature request for pre-flight testing of CPFP packages without mutating mempool state
